experiment: independent fixed-notional conditional directions trained in parallel

definition.objective: power-exp lambda=1 applied to n times unit-gross net P&L
definition.action: separate nonnegative long/short positions; gross sum is exactly one except for gated-feedforward, where a learned statewise activity scales it into [0,1]
definition.notional_independence: every notional has cold-started parameters and no gradient sharing
definition.partition: state-only learned soft router; local direction objectives are summed and physical partition masses are regularized towards equal mass
definition.validation: the entire fitted action is frozen and evaluated on the reciprocal half

source_split_ignored_for_this_experiment.weight_definition: exp(log(p/q)); physical estimates are N^-1 sum_r (p/q)_r f_r

fold.definition: component-stratified reciprocal 50/50 folds; fold 0 trains on the first half and fold 1 trains on the second

whitening.definition: xi_t=(x_t-m_t) Q_t Lambda_t^{-1/2}; m_t and covariance are estimated on training paths with physical p/q weights
